title: Button
description: A button with five variants, four sizes and a loading state that keeps focus and announces progress, on Radix, Base UI or React Aria.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual weight. Use one default button per view.

props.name: size
props.description: Height and padding. An icon button needs an aria-label.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and blocks activation while keeping focus: aria-disabled on Radix, focusableWhenDisabled on Base UI, isPending on React Aria.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Radix only: render the child element (for example a link) with button styles.

props.name: onPress
props.description: React Aria only: use onPress instead of onClick.

a11y: A native button element: Enter and Space activate it, and it is in the tab order.
Focus is always visible with a two-pixel ring in the ring token color.
While loading, focus stays on the button: Radix uses aria-disabled with a click guard, Base UI keeps a disabled button focusable, React Aria uses isPending, which also announces the pending state.
The spinner is aria-hidden and only spins when the user allows motion (motion-safe).
docs:
Installed `Button`. Import it from `@/components/ui/button`.

- `variant`: default, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive.
- `loading` shows a spinner and keeps focus on the button.

Colors come from your theme tokens (`--primary`, `--ring`, ...). Install `designfrom-theme` for the Design From palette.
